Claim 1 (Currently amended): A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a functional derivative thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.
